answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable identity bond combined with independent audits: each agent locks 40 POA for 10 epochs and earns only after unrelated peers validate distinct work. A duplicate identity or colluding auditor loses part of the bond, while honest agents recover it after compliant rounds. The ferrous registry records stake age, the falcon committee checks peer diversity, and the willow archive preserves evidence, so adding fake names creates cost and traceable risk.
